survey: Cartoon toy rocket, tilted up and to the right, flying against a blue sunburst. Main parts: (1) a red nose cone that sits on top of the silver body, with a rolled red rim covering the seam, its tip centred on the body axis; (2) a silver cylindrical body that tapers slightly toward the tail; (3) two round portholes with steel bezels and cyan glass, set one above the other on the camera-facing side, the lower one a little smaller from perspective; (4) two red swept fins at the tail, the left one on the front-left of the body and the right one on the right side, both with their root edges flush against the body (a third fin would be hidden behind it, which fits a three-fin layout); (5) a dark engine nozzle ring at the base, centred on the body; (6) a small yellow-orange exhaust flame coming straight out of the nozzle along the body axis. The rocket is in flight, so it needs no ground support. Every part is attached where it belongs, and the shape is a sound simplified rocket.
